name: memory-mv-remotion
description: 《把回忆拼好给你》Remotion 制作目录（渐进接入：旧 Canvas 引擎套壳 + CSS 3D 纸艺页面）

scripts.gate: rm -f out/gate_video.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts GatePage out/gate_video.mp4 --muted
scripts.final: rm -f out/final_video.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts FinalMV out/final_video.mp4 --muted
scripts.final-stills: rm -rf out/fs && remotion render src/index.ts FinalMV out/fs --image-format=jpeg --frames=
